items.name: Finsupp.support_mapRange
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {N : Type u_5} [Zero M] [Zero N] {f : M → N} {hf : f 0 = 0} {g : α →₀ M} : (Finsupp.mapRange f hf g).support ⊆ g.support

items.name: Finsupp.support_subset_iff
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [Zero M] {s : Set α} {f : α →₀ M} : ↑f.support ⊆ s ↔ ∀ a ∉ s, f a = 0

items.name: Finsupp.support_zipWith
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {N : Type u_5} {O : Type u_6} [Zero M] [Zero N] [Zero O] [D : DecidableEq α] {f : M → N → O} {hf : f 0 0 = 0} {g₁ : α →₀ M} {g₂ : α →₀ N} : (Finsupp.zipWith f hf g₁ g₂).support ⊆ g₁.support ∪ g₂.support

items.name: Finsupp.card_support_le_one'
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [Zero M] [Nonempty α] {f : α →₀ M} : f.support.card ≤ 1 ↔ ∃ a b, f = fun₀ | a => b

items.name: Finsupp.support_update_subset
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [Zero M] (f : α →₀ M) (a : α) {b : M} [DecidableEq α] : (f.update a b).support ⊆ insert a f.support
